hero.title: How we work
hero.lead: We've reverse-engineered what makes for a truly smooth project and built our entire delivery system from the ground up. Having experienced the frustrations of outsourcing ourselves, we know exactly where things go wrong. Here's how we've tackled each challenge to create a genuinely different experience

resources.title: What makes us happy
resources.body: Every practice works differently, and we adapt to your workflow rather than forcing you into ours. Whether you have a quick sketch on the back of an envelope or complete CAD drawings, our experienced designers can work with whatever you're able to share and fill in the gaps seamlessly.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.body: Most studios limit you to just one or two revision rounds, creating unnecessary pressure when your client inevitably has feedback. We build in an extra 20% time buffer for design changes from the start. This means you can refine and iterate without watching the clock or worrying about surprise charges.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: Most CGI studios keep their process mysterious, leaving designers guessing about timeframes. We believe in full transparency about how long each stage takes. For example, understanding that first drafts represent 80% of the total work helps designers plan better and gives valuable insight into the production process that most 3D teams simply don't share.

reviewing.title: Reviewing
reviewing.body: Our review process happens in stages to save time and avoid surprises. First, we share wireframe screenshots to confirm geometry and camera angles. Then comes low-resolution drafts where you can review textures and lighting. Only when everything looks perfect do we move to rendering the final high-resolution images.

cards.title: Screenshots
cards.body: Wireframe views to confirm we're building the right scene from the right angle before investing time in details.

cards.title: Draft resolution
cards.body: Your first glimpse of the final image. This is when most feedback happens and where we fine-tune everything together.

cards.title: High resolution
cards.body: We produce full-resolution renders only once you’re completely satisfied with the drafts, ensuring the final images match your expectations every time.

feedback.title: Feedback & Comments
feedback.body: We use Miro, a collaborative online platform that transforms how designers leave feedback. We're all too familiar with the frustrations of hunting through email chains for comments while chasing down missing feedback. Miro keeps everything tidy, organised, and immediately accessible for the whole design team.
